definitions.explanation: A large spiny lobster without big claws, caught off the Pacific coast of Japan and prized as a luxury food.

examples.japanese: {伊勢海老|いせえび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧だ。
examples.english: Japanese spiny lobster is a luxury ingredient.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おせち→おせち：09649_osechi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{伊勢海老|いせえび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っていた→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: There was a spiny lobster in the New Year osechi box.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夕食|ゆうしょく}→夕食：03006_yuushoku⟧で、{伊勢海老|いせえび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}てきた→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧。
examples.english: At dinner at the inn, they served spiny lobster sashimi.

notes:
Named after the Ise area of Mie Prefecture, a traditional source. Its bent back and long feelers suggest an old man with a beard, so it stands for long life and appears in New Year and wedding dishes. Also written イセエビ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {伊勢海老|いせえび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧: spiny lobster sashimi
- {伊勢海老|いせえび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{具足煮|ぐそくに}: spiny lobster simmered in its shell

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ロブスター: a lobster with large claws (American or European)
- ⟦{海老|えび}→海老：02272_ebi⟧: shrimp, prawn, lobster (general word)
